name: Mohmmadali
title: Freelance developer for GST compliance software and quick small-business tools
tagline: I build tax-form, e-filing and GST automation software, and I take small, fixed-scope jobs for CA firms and accounting/billing SaaS teams. I also build quick, fixed-price tools for small businesses: quotations, stock tracking and renewal reminders.
headline_capability: Automation for the Income Tax e-filing, TRACES and GST portals: bulk downloads, data extraction, status tracking and reconciliation workflows for CA firms.
about: I build tax-form and e-filing software professionally, so I know the details that break compliance code: schema versions, rounding rules, duplicate submissions and yearly rule changes.

Most of my work is automation around Indian tax portals (Income Tax e-filing, TRACES and GST): pulling documents and statuses in bulk, extracting data from PDFs and Excel files, and turning it into reconciled, reviewable reports for CA teams.
I take a small number of fixed-scope projects at a time, so each one gets careful, tested work and a clean handover.
work_types: Income Tax e-filing, TRACES and GST portal automation (bulk downloads, status tracking, data extraction)
GST reconciliation (GSTR-2B vs books) and e-invoice / e-way bill JSON
PDF redaction, invoice data extraction and document workflows
Email-driven workflows on Microsoft 365 (receivables follow-up, reminders, tracking)
strengths: Compliance-grade correctness: decimal-safe rounding, schema validation, golden tests
Bulk, resumable automation jobs with queues, retries and audit logs
Excel, CSV and PDF in and out, in the formats CA teams already use
Clean handover: README, tests and a short how-to-update guide

services.name: Form Generator
services.desc: One tax form or document: CSV/JSON/Excel in, filled PDF or schema-valid XML/JSON out (e.g. GST e-invoice JSON, ITR/TDS utility JSON). Includes schema validation, 10 golden test cases, a CLI or endpoint, and a README.

services.name: Connector
services.desc: One compliance or accounting API, sandbox to production: GST IRN/e-way bill via your GSP, Tally, Zoho Books, Xero or QuickBooks. Auth and token refresh, idempotent submits, status polling, error mapping and a sync log.

services.name: Rules Engine
services.desc: One tax calculation module (e.g. TDS) as versioned config with decimal-safe rounding, a calculation API, a worked-example report per case, 25+ golden tests and a how-to-update-next-year guide.

services.name: Portal Automation
services.desc: Automation for the Income Tax e-filing, TRACES and GST portals for CA firms: bulk downloads of returns, forms and notices, status tracking across many clients, data extraction into Excel, and reconciliation workflows. Runs on your machine or server, and you keep control of credentials.

selected_work.title: Income Tax and GST portal automation tools
selected_work.desc: Tools that automate bulk downloads, status checks and data extraction from the Income Tax e-filing and GST portals across many taxpayers, with job queues, retries and Excel/PDF output for CA teams.

selected_work.title: TDS computation and compliance tooling
selected_work.desc: Rules-driven TDS calculation with section-wise rates, thresholds and decimal-safe rounding, plus reports that show the working for each case.

selected_work.title: Receivables tracking app
selected_work.desc: A web app that tracks outstanding receivables and follow-ups: syncs email on Microsoft 365, sends reminders, logs every action, and gives each role its own view.

selected_work.title: Invoice data extraction and PDF redaction
selected_work.desc: Tools that pull invoice fields out of PDFs into structured rows for review, and redact sensitive details in PDFs before they are shared.

quick_tools.name: Quotation & proforma builder
quick_tools.desc: Your item master and rate card, GST split by state, weight or per-word pricing, your letterhead and terms, print/PDF, numbering by financial year, and a quote register with follow-up dates.

quick_tools.name: Stock tracker & channel check
quick_tools.desc: Inward/outward/returns/damaged log to live stock by SKU, size and colour, low-stock flags, a Shopify or marketplace stock comparison from their CSV exports, and a daily Excel report.

quick_tools.name: Renewals & fee reminders
quick_tools.desc: Reads your member or student sheet and lists who has expired, who is due this week, who is low on classes and who owes fees, with personalised reminder messages ready to copy.

compliance_tools.name: TDS credit check: 26AS / Form 168 vs books
compliance_tools.desc: Form 26AS or Form 168 Part I against your clients' books TDS receivable: matched by TAN, quarter, section and amount, with credit at risk per deductor, follow-up notes and an Excel export. The yearly fee covers section-393 table and format updates.

compliance_tools.name: Invoice & PO extractor: PDF to reviewed bills
compliance_tools.desc: Supplier invoice or PO PDFs (one document family) read into vendor, invoice number, dates, PO number, tax and line items with a confidence score per field, checked for totals, tax and duplicates, matched against open purchase orders, and exported as a bills file for QuickBooks Online, Xero, QuickBooks Desktop, Tally or Zoho Books. The live-push option creates draft bills in QuickBooks Online or Xero, or vouchers in Tally, for approval.
